description: Convert an amount between 30 currencies with the official euro foreign exchange reference rates of the European Central Bank, or get all rates for a base currency. Today's rate or any date in the last 90 days (weekends and holidays answer with the last published day, shown as rateDate). For invoices, price lists, accounting and reports. Rates are reference rates, published once per working day about 16:00 CET. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.001 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/currency-exchange-rates.

date.description: Rate date YYYY-MM-DD within the last 90 days (default: latest)

from.description: Currency you have, ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP (default EUR)

to.description: Currency or currencies you want, e.g. USD or USD,GBP,BGN (empty = all)

name: currency_exchange_rates
title: Currency Exchange Rates API - official ECB rates, convert 30 currencies
